howToPlay: Nani is a marksman who excels at dealing high damage by landing all three of her projectiles at their converging point. Use her Super to navigate Peep toward enemies for a powerful explosion, and utilize Warp Blast or Return To Sender to survive or catch opponents off guard.
gears: Equip DAMAGE for increased offensive pressure and SHIELD to boost your survivability given your health pool. SPEED or SUPER CHARGE are also excellent situational choices for map mobility and faster Super uptime.
trait: Nani suits players who enjoy high-risk, high-reward precision sniping and complex remote-controlled combat maneuvers.
